description: Build a modern AI SaaS landing page for “FlowBoard” — a collaborative project management platform for startups. Create a beautiful homepage with a glassmorphism design, dark theme, animated hero section, pricing cards, testimonials, FAQ, responsive navigation, authentication pages, dashboard layout, and reusable React components. Generate production-ready code using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui. Ensure accessibility, smooth animations, and clean component architecture.
